_comment: Golden prompts for scripts/eval.py --agent archaeologist. expected_tools is a SUBSEQUENCE of the streamed tool calls; forbidden_text must not appear anywhere in the stream (the agent's words and its tool inputs). reverse_geocode (ArcGIS MCP) is never expected: the gate must not fail on a third-party outage. The terrain is pre-built (scripts/build_site_catalogue.py); nothing here reads 3DEP live. The act beats come first (great-circle-measure and octagon-wall-measure are the stage's two measure plates, word for word: the Great Circle on the record's verified line with no bearing, the Octagon on a bearing the agent picks after inspecting the local relief, so inspect_image comes before measure_profile; 'I cannot confirm a bank on this line.' is a pass), then the provocations that must decline with the fixed sentences and call no search.

prompts.name: octagon-from-space
prompts.prompt: Show me the Newark Octagon the way an archaeologist sees it

prompts.name: octagon-wall-measure
prompts.prompt: Measure across a wall of the Newark Octagon, on a line you choose from the local relief.

prompts.name: great-circle-measure
prompts.prompt: Measure the Great Circle: how wide is it, how high is the bank, how deep is the ditch?
